Reason: The provided axial CT image demonstrates a soft tissue mass in the left paratracheal/mediastinal region (left hilum area) that is compressing or invading the trachea and likely affecting the recurrent laryngeal nerve, which explains the patient's dysphonia. On a chest X-ray, this pathology would manifest as enlargement of the left hilum or mediastinal widening, correlating with the central airway involvement seen on the scan.
